title: Safe in the Arms of Jesus
description: Safe in the Arms of Jesus in Tonic Solfa to REFUGE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Fanny Crosby wrote the words in 1868 for a tune William H. Doane had written, published the same year.
underlay: Safe in the arms of Je_-sus, Safe on His gen-tle breast; There by His love o’er-shad_-ed, Sweet_-ly my soul shall rest. Hark! ’tis the voice of an-gels Borne in a song to me_, O-ver the fields of glo-ry, O-ver the jas-per sea_. Safe in the arms of Je_-sus, Safe on His gen-tle breast; There by His love o’er-shad_-ed, Sweet_-ly my soul shall rest.

lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Borne in a song to me,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears;
Firm on the Rock of Ages
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o’er;
Wait till I see the morning
